hardware: Apple M1 Ultra, 64 GB RAM, macOS 27.0.1; Python 3.13.7, numpy 2.5.4. Everything here is single-threaded CPU work.
note: The lab's tests and server use mock models, so no row measures a model's quality. Speed rows: median of 5 timed runs after a warm-up; other workloads shared the machine, but these single-threaded timings were within 2% of an earlier run. Statistics rows come from simulation with the lab's own bootstrap_ci and paired_bootstrap_test (fixed seeds). The optional GPT-2 check (--gpt2) is reported in the MDX only: 10 examples per task are too few to compare methods.
